sources.excerpt: In women's rugby union, Canada defeats England 24–21 in a WXV Global Series match in Toronto, ending the Red Roses' four-year unbeaten run at 41 matches (the longest in rugby union history) after Shoshanah Seumanutafa scores a late try.
With all votes counted, governing ANO 2011 did not win any of the 27 contested seats, and lost the only seat they defended in this election.

Mayors and Independents party won the most contested seats in this election with nine, but also losing a one seat overall. Czech Pirate Party in this election lost their only seat in the Senate, ending with no representation in the chamber for the first time since 2012.
